item.title: Weekend Warrior Tennis (Sundays) — Sun Aug 2, 8:00 AM
item.description:
North Jersey Bowling, Volleyball, Tennis And More We meet at 9AM unless one or more people comment wanting to meet at 8AM which is my preferred time. You’re welcome to show up any time but are encouraged to post it so we have a better idea of what to expect for that day. (Those who share the same comment for start time can simply like that comment so we see how many show up for that time without potentially cluttering the comments.)
**RULES:** By signing up you agree to follow these rules:
1\. No instruction or orders are allowed on any of our group courts\. If two or more people are in agreement then they’re welcome to exchange instructions so long as they relinquish their court positions and don’t disrupt active players\. If anyone is instructing or ordering you and you’re not comfortable then please tell them or let me know\. Everyone should feel free to play however they wish without being directed without agreement\, most especially beginners\.
2\. No formal matches are allowed

item.title: Mindful Masculinity Men’s Group — Wed Aug 5, 7:00 PM — The Space
item.description:
We Meet Bi-Weekly Every Other Wednesday | 7 – 8:30 pm | $15 August 5 , 2026 Through open dialogue, mindfulness, and other calming practices we quiet the mind, open the heart, and deepen our connection to ourselves and each other. The meetings are hosted by Leo, mindfulness coach, teacher, and dad. We start by sharing our wins and challenges, honoring each voice without judgment or advice. We dive into practices that help us release stress, shift perspectives, and bring awareness and resilience into our lives. Each week, we focus on a different topic to help guide our lives. Together, we explore themes of trust, accomplishments, family, rest, intimacy, and presence — discovering new ways to move through the world as mindful men. Come as you are. Leave more grounded, connected, and inspired. Connect with Leo and the group on Instagram @holdingpresence
Source: The Space For Art

item.description:

In this mediation session we will bring our attention here: to the inner body. Sessions are suitable for newcomers, those experienced in Tolle's teachings and anyone wishing to remain completely anonymous. See you there!
Please be aware that sessions will close if no members have joined after 10 minutes.

item.title: In-Person and Live Stream Service — Sun Sep 6, 10:00 AM — Sanctuary
item.description:
Sunday worship takes place at 10am in person at 176 Cooper Avenue in Montclair or livestreamed on our YouTube channel: Sunday Worship Livestream Union Congregational Church is located in Montclair, New Jersey, at 176 Cooper Avenue (nearest major cross streets are Grove Street and Valley Road). There is street parking on Cooper Avenue. We have a small parking lot for seniors and those with limited mobility reached through a driveway to the left of the church. There are two accessible spots and a ramp on the left side of the building. Additional parking is available on neighboring streets. Please note that Cooper Avenue runs one way on Sundays, so it is best to enter from Valley Road or Northview Avenue. Enter the church through the main Sanctuary doors under the tower or through the accessible entrance through the Assembly Room at the top of the ramp on the left side of the church. item.title: World Movie Night: It Was Just an Accident — Thu Jul 23, 6:30 PM — West Orange - Community Room 2
item.description:
Watch and read your way around the world with us this summer with our World Movie Night and World Literature series!
Playing in our World Championship Challenge? Here's a fine Group D pick for your consideration:
IT WAS JUST AN ACCIDENT (2025) directed by Jafar Panahi (Iran) PG-13, 1h 44min
A mechanic is reminded of his time in an Iranian prison when he encounters a man he suspects to be his jailhouse tormentor. Panicked, he rounds up a few of his fellow ex-prisoners to confirm the man's identity. Written and directed by acclaimed Iranian filmmaker Jafar Panahi, the film was nominated for two Academy Awards and won the Palme D'Or Award at Cannes, the NY Film Critics Circle Award for Best Director, and the Audience Award for World Cinema at the Montclair Film Festival.
